title: A dead-letter queue
description:
Keep failed records aside and retry them later, so one bad record does not stop the rest.

```
sent 1, 2, 4
3 failed (bad email) -> dead letters
retry dead letters after the email was fixed: 3 sent
```
hints: Wrap each `send` in `try` / `except Exception as e` and append `{"record": r, "error": str(e), "attempts": 1}` (lesson 5.04).
Build a new list in `retry_dead_letters` instead of removing from the list you are looping over.
requirements: Process every record; failures go into a list with the record, the error and the attempt count.
`retry_dead_letters()` tries them again and removes those that now succeed.
After 3 attempts, a record stays in the dead letters with a `gave up` note.
stretch: Write the dead letters to a file so an operator can look at them.
